user_decision: Two visible bank worksheets CardXabar and HUMO Card; portable common profile, automatic bidirectional sync

checks: CardXabar: all 17 native SheetChange edits round-trip; code=label becomes code; Unicode, literal equals, leading zeros, exact cents and local dates
CardXabar: copying unchanged decorated T creates no intent/outbox/API operation and preserves the server version
CardXabar: p2p_confirmed false/true/null is independent of is_p2p; optional fields clear to null and raw text to empty
CardXabar: native partial draft inherits excel_bank, defaults confirmation to null, and all 17 fields create exactly one receipt in place
HUMO Card: all 17 native SheetChange edits round-trip; code=label becomes code; Unicode, literal equals, leading zeros, exact cents and local dates
HUMO Card: copying unchanged decorated T creates no intent/outbox/API operation and preserves the server version

HUMO Card: native partial draft inherits excel_bank, defaults confirmation to null, and all 17 fields create exactly one receipt in place
CardXabar: two no-op cycles preserve manual hidden row, multi-area selection, active UUID, all panes, zoom, freeze, Saved, SHA256 and write time
CardXabar: server deletion above selection preserves selected UUIDs, top UUID and every frozen pane anchor
HUMO Card: two no-op cycles preserve manual hidden row, multi-area selection, active UUID, all panes, zoom, freeze, Saved, SHA256 and write time
HUMO Card: server deletion above selection preserves selected UUIDs, top UUID and every frozen pane anchor

HUMO Card: inactive deletion defers and locks stale rows; activation reconstructs the view around the same selected UUIDs
CardXabar: native offline edit survives actual owned workbook close/reopen, retains its viewport and reaches the server after recovery
HUMO Card: native offline edit survives actual owned workbook close/reopen, retains its viewport and reaches the server after recovery
CardXabar: lost create ACK and failed retry preserve one immutable operation and bank order; success replaces the local UUID in place exactly once
HUMO Card: lost create ACK and failed retry preserve one immutable operation and bank order; success replaces the local UUID in place exactly once
Native copy blocks all sync HTTP and cell changes, preserves clipboard/view, and resumes after ending only the owned copy mode
HUMO create ACK while CardXabar is active survives actual close/reopen; durable alias preserves draft order, selection and active receipt on first HUMO activation
Explicit SortByDate preserves selected UUID on both banks; invoking it with an owned foreign CardXabar sheet active changes neither workbook and does not steal focus

final_zero_guard.reason: VBA IsNumeric(Empty)=True; distinguish an empty cell from an actual numeric zero

limits: Windows desktop Excel with licensed macro execution required; web/mobile Excel do not run VBA.
Previously distributed books need this updated private copy after their pending edits are sent; copying XLSM does not copy an offline queue.
Synchronization is synchronous and may briefly make Excel busy; the no-op tests verify stable view/file, not zero execution latency.
Static exports and frontend were not changed by this two-bank live-workbook release.
